## Income Funds
* JPMorgan Equity Premium Income ETF (JEPI)
* Global X NASDAQ 100 Covered Call ETF (QYLD)
* Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF( SCHD)

```{r, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyquant)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(tsibble)
library(fable)
library(feasts)
library(TTR)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(fable.prophet)
library(prophet)
library(ggtime)
```

##  JPMorgan Equity Premium Income ETF (JEPI)

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

# ---- settings ----
# tickers
symbol <- c("JEPI","QYLD","SCHD")
from_date <- "2025-04-01"
week_start_day <- 1
h_weeks <- 12
history_weeks <- 26

# Fixed Prophet training start dates and forecast anchor
params <- list(
  start_date_6m   = as.Date("2025-10-01"),
  start_date_12m  = as.Date("2025-04-01"),
  forecast_start  = as.Date("2026-04-01"),
  forecast_horizon = 30
)

# ---- daily data ----
daily <- tq_get("JEPI", get = "stock.prices", from = from_date) %>%
  select(date, close, adjusted) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    EMA_21  = EMA(close, 21),
    SMA_100 = SMA(close, 100)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    MACD = MACD(close)[, "macd"],
    Signal = MACD(close)[, "signal"],
    Histogram = MACD - Signal
  )

# Weekly aggregation
weekly <- daily %>%
  mutate(week = floor_date(date, "week", week_start = week_start_day)) %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  summarise(close = mean(close, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  as_tsibble(index = week)

# Prophet helper ----
run_prophet_forecast <- function(data, start_date, forecast_start, horizon_days = 30) {
  train <- data %>%
    filter(date >= start_date,
           date < forecast_start) %>%
    transmute(ds = as.Date(date), y = close)

  m <- prophet(
    train,
    yearly.seasonality = TRUE,
    weekly.seasonality = TRUE,
    daily.seasonality = FALSE
  )

  future <- make_future_dataframe(
    m,
    periods = 60,
    freq = "day",
    include_history = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(ds = as.Date(ds)) %>%
    filter(ds >= forecast_start) %>%
    filter(weekdays(ds) %in% c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday")) %>%
    slice_head(n = horizon_days)

  fc <- predict(m, future) %>%
    transmute(
      ds = as.Date(ds),
      yhat,
      yhat_lower,
      yhat_upper
    )

  list(train = train, forecast = fc)
}

prophet_6m <- run_prophet_forecast(
  daily,
  start_date = params$start_date_6m,
  forecast_start = params$forecast_start,
  horizon_days = params$forecast_horizon
)

prophet_12m <- run_prophet_forecast(
  daily,
  start_date = params$start_date_12m,
  forecast_start = params$forecast_start,
  horizon_days = params$forecast_horizon
)
```

```{r}
# Models + forecast

fits <- weekly %>%
  model(
    ETS     = ETS(close),
    ARIMA   = ARIMA(close),
    # PROPHET = prophet(close ~ season("year", 52)),
    NAIVE   = NAIVE(close)
  )

fc_weekly <- fits %>% forecast(h = h_weeks)

fit_stats <- fits %>%
  accuracy() %>%
  select(.model, ME, MAE, RMSE, MAPE, MASE, ACF1)
```

```{r}
# Performance calculations

perf <- daily %>%
  tq_transmute(
    select = adjusted,
    mutate_fun = periodReturn,
    period = "daily",
    type = "arithmetic",
    col_rename = "returns"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    wealth = cumprod(1 + returns),
    cumulative_returns = wealth - 1,
    value_10000 = 10000 * wealth,
    peak_value = cummax(value_10000),
    drawdown = value_10000 / peak_value - 1
  )
```

## Close with 21 Day EMA & 100 Day SMA

```{r}
daily %>%
  filter(date >= max(date) - days(180)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = close, color = "Close"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = EMA_21, color = "EMA 21"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = SMA_100, color = "SMA 100"), linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = paste(symbol, "Close with EMA & SMA"),
       y = "Price", x = NULL)
```

## MacD Plot


## First and Last close by Month

```{r}
# Filter to most recent 12 months
recent_daily <- daily %>%
  filter(date >= max(date) - months(12))

# Summarise monthly first/last close
month_summary <- recent_daily %>%
  mutate(Month = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    FirstDate  = first(date),
    LastDate   = last(date),
    FirstClose = first(close),
    LastClose  = last(close),
    Direction  = ifelse(LastClose >= FirstClose, "Up", "Down"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Pivot longer → 2 rows per month
month_points <- month_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(FirstDate, LastDate, FirstClose, LastClose),
    names_to = c("Type", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(First|Last)(.*)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(MonthLabel = format(Month, "%b %Y")) %>%
  mutate(MonthLabel = factor(MonthLabel, levels = rev(unique(MonthLabel))))

# Horizontal plot
ggplot(month_points,
       aes(x = Close, y = MonthLabel, group = Month, color = Direction)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Type), size = 3) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(First = 16, Last = 17)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Up = "forestgreen", Down = "firebrick")) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Monthly First ↔ Last Closing Prices for", symbol),
    subtitle = "Last 12 Months | Green = Up | Red = Down",
    x = "Closing Price ($)",
    y = "Month"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)
  )
```

### Bollinger Bands

```{r}
VASGX_bb <- daily %>%  filter(date >="2026-01-01") |>
  tq_mutate(select = close, mutate_fun = BBands) |> na.omit()

ggplot(VASGX_bb, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = dn, ymax = up), fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = close), color = "blue", linewidth= 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = up), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(aes(y = dn), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(aes(y = mavg), color = "darkgreen", linetype = "dotdash") +
  labs(title = "Bollinger Bands (YTD)", x = "Date", y = "Closing Price") +
  theme_tq()

```

## Prophet Forecast (30 Trading Days, 6 Months Training Data)

```{r}
prophet_6m_plot_data <- bind_rows(
  prophet_6m$train %>% mutate(series = "Actual") %>% rename(value = y),
  prophet_6m$forecast %>% mutate(series = "Forecast") %>% rename(value = yhat)
)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = prophet_6m$train,
    aes(x = ds, y = y, color = "Actual"),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = prophet_6m$forecast,
    aes(x = ds, ymin = yhat_lower, ymax = yhat_upper),
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = prophet_6m$forecast,
    aes(x = ds, y = yhat, color = "Forecast"),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.numeric(params$forecast_start),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(symbol, "Prophet Forecast - 30 Trading Days"),
    subtitle = paste("Training:", params$start_date_6m, "to", params$forecast_start - 1, "| Forecast starts:", params$forecast_start),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Close"
  )
```

## Prophet Forecast Overlay Comparison

```{r}
overlay_actual <- daily %>%
  filter(date >= max(date) - months(12)) %>%
  select(ds = date, y = close)

overlay_forecast <- bind_rows(
  prophet_6m$forecast %>%
    transmute(ds, yhat, Model = "Prophet 6M"),
  prophet_12m$forecast %>%
    transmute(ds, yhat, Model = "Prophet 12M")
)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = overlay_actual,
    aes(x = ds, y = y, color = "Actual"),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = overlay_forecast,
    aes(x = ds, y = yhat, color = Model),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.numeric(params$forecast_start),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(symbol, "Prophet Forecast Comparison"),
    subtitle = paste("30 trading-day forecast from", params$forecast_start, "| training starts:", params$start_date_6m, "vs", params$start_date_12m),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Close",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Model Disagreement Dashboard

```{r}
# Build disagreement dataset
forecast_compare <- prophet_6m$forecast %>%
  rename(
    forecast_6m = yhat,
    lower_6m = yhat_lower,
    upper_6m = yhat_upper
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    prophet_12m$forecast %>%
      rename(
        forecast_12m = yhat,
        lower_12m = yhat_lower,
        upper_12m = yhat_upper
      ),
    by = "ds"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    abs_diff = abs(forecast_6m - forecast_12m),
    pct_diff = abs_diff / ((forecast_6m + forecast_12m) / 2),
    higher_model = case_when(
      forecast_6m > forecast_12m ~ "Prophet 6M",
      forecast_12m > forecast_6m ~ "Prophet 12M",
      TRUE ~ "Tie"
    )
  )

summary_metrics <- tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Forecast start",
    "Forecast horizon (trading days)",
    "6M final forecast",
    "12M final forecast",
    "Final-day absolute gap",
    "Final-day percent gap",
    "Average gap across horizon",
    "Maximum gap across horizon",
    "Higher on final day"
  ),
  Value = c(
    as.character(min(forecast_compare$ds)),
    as.character(nrow(forecast_compare)),
    sprintf("%.2f", last(forecast_compare$forecast_6m)),
    sprintf("%.2f", last(forecast_compare$forecast_12m)),
    sprintf("%.2f", last(forecast_compare$abs_diff)),
    percent(last(forecast_compare$pct_diff), accuracy = 0.1),
    sprintf("%.2f", mean(forecast_compare$abs_diff)),
    sprintf("%.2f", max(forecast_compare$abs_diff)),
    last(forecast_compare$higher_model)
  )
)

recent_actual <- daily %>%
  filter(date >= params$forecast_start - months(6)) %>%
  transmute(ds = date, close)

forecast_long <- forecast_compare %>%
  select(ds, forecast_6m, forecast_12m) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ds, names_to = "model", values_to = "forecast") %>%
  mutate(
    model = recode(
      model,
      forecast_6m = "Prophet 6M",
      forecast_12m = "Prophet 12M"
    )
  )

p_overlay <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = recent_actual,
    aes(x = ds, y = close, color = "Actual"),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = forecast_long,
    aes(x = ds, y = forecast, color = model),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.numeric(params$forecast_start),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Forecast paths",
    subtitle = "Actual close plus 6M and 12M Prophet forecasts",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Close",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_gap <- ggplot(forecast_compare, aes(x = ds, y = abs_diff)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(forecast_compare$abs_diff), linetype = "dotted") +
  labs(
    title = "Disagreement gap by day",
    subtitle = "Absolute difference between 6M and 12M forecasts",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Absolute gap"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

final_day_tbl <- forecast_compare %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  transmute(
    model_6m = forecast_6m,
    model_12m = forecast_12m
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "model", values_to = "forecast") %>%
  mutate(
    model = recode(
      model,
      model_6m = "Prophet 6M",
      model_12m = "Prophet 12M"
    )
  )

p_final <- ggplot(final_day_tbl, aes(x = model, y = forecast, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Final-day forecast",
    subtitle = paste("Forecast date:", max(forecast_compare$ds)),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Forecast close"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

(p_overlay / (p_gap | p_final)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = paste(symbol, "Model Disagreement Dashboard"),
    subtitle = paste(
      "Forecast start:", params$forecast_start,
      "| 6M start:", params$start_date_6m,
      "| 12M start:", params$start_date_12m
    )
  )
```
